First up let's talk about the money costs. To treat T1D every day, I have to purchase: -Insulin -Cannulas (the tiny tube that is inserted into my stomach every three days that lets my pump deliver insulin) -Reservoirs (to hold insulin)

If you're in the US, this could be $5,000 - $10,000 a year, depending on your health insurance, maybe more. Luckily I live in Australia which has all of these heavily subsidised. I also have to get a new insulin pump every 4 years, a piece of equipment costing ~$7,000 USD
